Imidacloprid in the water of an insecticide and temperature mesocosm experiment

Source: R/data.R
hermann_imidacloprid.Rd

Measured imidacloprid concentrations in the treated mesocosms of the experiment of Hermann et al. (2024) with an insecticide and three temperature regimes.

Usage

hermann_imidacloprid

Format

A data frame with 120 rows (12 treated mesocosms x 10 days) and 4 columns:

mesocosm

Mesocosm number (text), as in hermann_water_quality; only those with imidacloprid.

day

Day relative to the first imidacloprid application (integer: 0, 3, 10, 14, 17, 24, 28, 31, 38, 45). The article describes the samples of day 0 as taken 4 hours after the application.

temperature

"ambient", "elevated" or "heatwaves".

concentration

Imidacloprid in water (µg/L).

The concentration is missing in mesocosm "M20" on days 28, 31 and 38; there are no other missing values.

Source

Hermann et al. (2024), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.11520459 (full reference in hermann_zooplankton). Licence CC BY 4.0. Sheet "ImiConcentrationsWater"; script data-raw/hermann_2024.R of the source repository.

Experimental design

Twenty-four outdoor mesocosms (about 850 L of water over a sediment layer) at Alcalá de Henares (central Spain), from 19 April (day -7) to 19 July 2021, four per combination of a 2 x 3 factorial: imidacloprid (nominal 1 µg/L, applied on days 0, 14 and 28, or absent) and temperature (ambient; elevated, 4 °C above ambient; or three heatwaves of 7 days, separated by 7 days at ambient temperature, with targets of 24, 28 and 32 °C). The temperature treatments lasted from day 0 to day 42; days 42 to 84 were a recovery phase.

The community tables hermann_zooplankton, hermann_phytoplankton and hermann_macroinvertebrates code the mesocosms by treatment and replicate number ("C0A1"); hermann_water_quality, hermann_nutrients, hermann_leaf_litter and hermann_imidacloprid by mesocosm number ("M01"). The source gives no correspondence between the two codings, so the two kinds of table cannot be joined by mesocosm.

References

Hermann, M., Polazzo, F., Cherta, L., Crettaz-Minaglia, M., García-Astillero, A., Peeters, E. T. H. M., Rico, A., & Van den Brink, P. J. (2024). Combined stress of an insecticide and heatwaves or elevated temperature induce community and food web effects in a Mediterranean freshwater ecosystem. Water Research, 260, 121903. doi:10.1016/j.watres.2024.121903

See also

Other data of Hermann et al. (2024): hermann_leaf_litter, hermann_macroinvertebrates, hermann_nutrients, hermann_phytoplankton, hermann_water_quality, hermann_zooplankton

Examples

with(hermann_imidacloprid, round(tapply(concentration, list(temperature, day),
                                        mean, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
#>              0    3   10   14   17   24   28   31   38   45
#> ambient   1.14 0.79 0.23 1.35 0.88 0.20 1.19 0.62 0.15 0.11
#> elevated  1.17 0.74 0.18 1.44 0.87 0.19 1.33 0.58 0.10 0.03
#> heatwaves 1.23 0.82 0.22 1.43 0.81 0.17 1.33 0.54 0.12 0.03
